overrides.target_population: the 9,417 outcome-free confirmation-role pairs after official zero-crossing image allocation
overrides.training_sample: the 445 formally sampled development pairs joined to the outcome-free master derivation frame
overrides.calibration_sample: the 445 formally sampled calibration pairs joined to the outcome-free master derivation frame

three_stage_design.stage_1: fit active-control and full models on synthetic development outcomes
three_stage_design.stage_2: fit separate intercept-and-slope logistic recalibrators on synthetic calibration outcomes
three_stage_design.stage_3: evaluate calibrated probabilities against synthetic truth over the full confirmation-role outcome-free frame

overrides.calibration_policy_for_simulation: separate unpenalized intercept-and-slope logistic recalibration for active and full predictions
overrides.claim_boundary: Three-stage simulation ranks design strategies under declared synthetic mechanisms. It uses no observed outcome, does not select a fitted PF-ERI model, and cannot unlock real calibration or confirmation.
